prerequisites: Basic knowledge of manufacturing processes and their selection based on product and components.
Notions of design and its relationship with involved manufacturing processes.
Basic knowledge of dimensional metrology and geometric product specification standards.
Knowledge required for admission to the Master's program.
Knowledge acquired during the first year of the Master's program.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand 3D scanning techniques and their practical application.
Understand and use reverse engineering techniques applied to surface reconstruction.
Understand the issues associated with the design and manufacturing of parts using additive manufacturing.
Understand the fundamentals and technologies of coordinate measurement.
Acquire practical skills in handling coordinate measuring devices and machines and in exploiting metrological results.

assessment_methods.method: Tests of Execution of Real and/or Simulated Tasks

assessment_rules: In the ordinary call, evaluation is based on works and projects (50%), a written test of general knowledge (30%), and tests of execution of real and/or simulated tasks (20%). In extraordinary calls and for differentiated evaluation, students must complete a theoretical-practical test representing 100% of the global grade, covering all course content and knowledge. Differentiated evaluation must be requested within the deadlines and criteria established by the University of Oviedo regulations.
